source_evidence: Player exact 'Precisely. Do you want to travel with us?' directed invitation to the existing roadside wool carter and sister. Voluntary acceptance fits carter's established independent ordinary safe passage objective and sister's cross-border family visit; he prefers to continue toward Orsaven and she may depart to visit relatives/graves. Not an offer of hire, combat assistance, payment, magical aid, guaranteed protection, or classified information. Shared travel proceeds at compatible ordinary coach/wagon pace for about90 minutes; no actual crossing or new encounter. G1: shared household ties and continued trade amid disputed Crown consistent with world/politics/human-states.md and geography-seats.md; G2: voluntary joint passage, can separate, no forced quest; G3: routine social agreement aligned with their goals, no contested roll or reward, prior D320 social occurrence consumes that travel day's random encounter. Latest correction D320-VALUABLES-PRIVATE-KNOWLEDGE-CORRECTION-001 controls all money and knowledge; no invented title disclosure. D320~13:30 westbound Caereth→Orsaven coach route on Crownsunder side, within frontier approach, crossing not yet reached or made. V's exact reply 'Precisely. Do you want to travel with us?' voluntarily invites existing wool carter and his adult sister to share the road. Carter accepts ordinary company at compatible loaded-wagon pace, intending to continue toward Orsaven; sister willingly accompanies through crossing but intends to visit family/graves on Ossent side and may part ways there. No paid escort, service contract, guarantee of safety, extra party supply charge, custody change, route change or military information. Two vehicles travel together for about90 minutes toward the crossing, with ordinary road conditions and local knowledge; no new random encounter (D320 social event already used), no border inspection or passage yet. Carter/sister know own family and ordinary past crossings, nothing of confidential letter, Kestrel, hidden perpetrators or party's loot provenance; no new privileged rumor. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar and own coach/four horses healthy, Elara remains Caereth. Leg planned8days D317–324, cap5, 1 encounter day D320 consecutive1; skip D320 random night check; full D320 provisions debit and rest not yet applied. Rations12/feed16, weighted LR5/6; V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 Boots of Elvenkind equipped; Mara and horses healthy. Purse3178gp4sp6cp, all authorized listed loot sales completed once, no pending 240gp offer or clerk inquiry. Sealed diplomatic invitation and limited credentials V-held, Crown intelligence commission remaining300+1300, Coris scholarly commission remaining300/800, original Kestrel exhibits unchanged, Crown copies retained; Severin assent unconfirmed. Standing V dice delegation. Await V's next conversation/action or continue to crossing.
